## The claim

A second oracle upload is not informative: the expected information gain over a pre-registered decode table is 0 bits.

**Prediction if true.** tools/design_submission.py, run on the iteration-2 hypothesis space, reports expected information gain of 0.000 bits for every candidate row layout, so the default of no second upload stands.
